conversation.standfirst: Write or speak to the AI tutor about anything. It answers in short, clear messages and corrects you gently as you go.
conversation.heroAlt: A finished chat in Tutelage AI about planning a trip to Japan, with the session report underneath
conversation.flowText: Every chat is a short session. You write or speak, the tutor answers at your level, and you leave with clear feedback.

s1.name: Start
s1.text: Open a new chat and type, tap the mic, or pick a topic. It is saved after your first message.

s2.name: Talk
s2.text: The tutor answers at your level, points out good words and fixes mistakes without stopping the chat.

s3.name: Review
s3.text: When you finish, you get a score, your level and one thing to practise next.

n1.name: Your chats
n1.text: Every conversation is kept here with a title. Search, pin or delete them.

n2.name: New chat
n2.text: Starts a blank chat. Nothing is saved until you send something.

n3.name: Your message
n3.text: Type in English, or record your voice and send it.

n4.name: Tutor reply
n4.text: Short and friendly, and it tells you when you used a good word.

n5.name: Level
n5.text: The level the tutor hears in your English, from A1 to C2.

n6.name: Session report
n6.text: Your score, your level, what went well and what to practise next.

conversation.whyStatement: You learn faster when you use English, not only when you read about it.

s1.name: Always there
s1.text: Practise at any hour, as often as your plan allows.

s2.name: No pressure
s2.text: Make mistakes freely. Corrections are short and kind.

s3.name: A clear next step
s3.text: Each chat ends with what you did well and what to practise.

q1.q: Do I need to be good at English already?
q1.a: No. The tutor matches your level, from beginner (A1) up, and keeps its answers short and simple.

q2.q: Can I speak instead of typing?
q2.a: Yes. Tap the mic, record and send. The tutor answers in text, and out loud on Gold and Premium.

q3.q: How many chats can I have?
q3.a: Free: 3 chats and 20 messages a day. Gold: 15 chats a day. Premium: 50 chats a day.

q4.q: What if I forget to end a chat?
q4.a: Nothing is lost. A chat closes by itself after 24 hours without a message, and your practice still counts.

q5.a: Free uses Gemini Flash Lite, Gold uses Gemini Flash, and Premium uses GPT-5 mini.

q6.q: Can my teacher read my chats?
q6.a: If you join a class, your teacher sees your progress and common mistakes, with short examples from your chats.

voice.standfirst: Voice Lab is a hands-free call with the AI tutor. You talk, it listens, answers out loud and scores how you did.
voice.heroAlt: The Voice Lab screen in Tutelage AI with the Start call button and the live scoring panel
voice.flowText: A call works like a phone call with a patient teacher. There is nothing to hold down and nothing to send.

s1.name: Call
s1.text: Press Start call and allow the microphone. One press, and you are talking.

s2.name: Talk
s2.text: Speak naturally. When you pause, the tutor takes its turn and answers out loud.

s3.name: See
s3.text: After each turn, your grammar, vocabulary and fluency scores update next to the call.

n1.name: Start call
n1.text: One press starts the call. Mute or hang up at any time.

n2.name: How a call works
n2.text: Just talk. It replies on its own when you pause.

n3.name: Live scoring
n3.text: Your scores update after every turn you speak.

n4.name: Word by word
n4.text: On Gold and Premium, every word you say is scored too.

voice.whyStatement: Speaking is the hardest skill to practise alone. Now you don’t have to.

s1.name: Real conversation
s1.text: You answer in real time, like talking to a person.

s2.name: Safe to try
s2.text: Only the tutor is listening, so try again as often as you like.

s3.name: Feedback right away
s3.text: See what to fix while the call is still going.

q1.a: A phone or computer with a microphone, and a browser that is allowed to use it.

q2.a: No, but they help the tutor hear you clearly in a noisy room.

q3.a: Yes. Each call is saved with your chats, so you can read it again later.

q4.q: Is Voice Lab in the Free plan?
q4.a: Yes, once your email is verified. Word-by-word pronunciation scores need Gold or Premium.

q5.q: Does a call count as practice?
q5.a: Yes. Your minutes, streak and skills update as you speak.

vocab.standfirst: Save new words, then review them as flashcards. The app brings each word back just before you would forget it.
vocab.heroAlt: A vocabulary flashcard for the word reluctant in Tutelage AI, next to the mastery breakdown
vocab.flowText: Your word list grows by itself as you chat, and a few minutes of review a day keeps it in your memory.

s1.name: Collect
s1.text: Words are added from your chats, by you, or by your teacher.

s2.name: Review
s2.text: Flip the cards that are due today and say how well you knew each one.

s3.name: Master
s3.text: Good answers send a word further away: 1 day, 3, 7, then 21 and more.

n1.name: The card
n1.text: The word, its meaning, its type and an example sentence.

n2.name: Your answer
n2.text: Again, Hard, Good or Easy. It decides when the card comes back.

n3.name: Today
n3.text: New, due and learned cards at a glance.

n4.name: Mastery
n4.text: Each word moves from Seen to Mastered as you review it.

n5.name: Today’s progress
n5.text: How far you are through today’s cards.

n6.name: Add word
n6.text: Save any word you meet, with your own example.

vocab.whyStatement: Reviewing at the right moment beats reviewing more.

s1.name: Less time
s1.text: You only see the words that are due today.

s2.name: Longer memory
s2.text: Every good answer moves the next review further away.

s3.name: Your own words
s3.text: The list grows from your chats, so you learn words you really use.

q1.q: Where do the words come from?
q1.a: From your AI chats, from words you add yourself, and from words your teacher gives you.

q2.q: How is the next review chosen?
q2.a: The app uses the SM-2 spaced repetition method: your answer sets how many days pass before the card returns.

q3.q: What if I miss a day?
q3.a: Nothing is lost. Cards stay due until you review them.

q4.q: Can I add my own words?
q4.a: Yes. Press Add word and write the word, its meaning and an example.

q5.a: When you keep answering well and the gap before its next review grows past 21 days.

pronunciation.standfirst: When you speak, the app scores how you sound. On Gold and Premium it checks every word and tells you which ones need work.
pronunciation.heroAlt: The Skills panel on the Tutelage AI dashboard, with the speaking score from spoken messages
pronunciation.flowText: Your voice is compared word by word with clear speech, and the result comes back as scores and short tips.

s1.name: Speak
s1.text: Talk in Voice Lab, or send a voice message in a chat.

s2.name: Score
s2.text: Each word is checked for how clearly and completely you said it.

s3.name: Fix
s3.text: You see the words that need work, each with a short tip.

n1.name: Skills
n1.text: Grammar, vocabulary, fluency and speaking, each with a plain word next to the number.

n2.name: What it is based on
n2.text: Your latest scored messages, and how many of them were spoken.

n3.name: Speaking
n3.text: The average of your pronunciation scores.

n4.name: Voice chats
n4.text: Calls and voice messages are marked with a microphone.

pronunciation.whyStatement: Small sounds change how well people understand you.

s1.name: Exact
s1.text: You learn which words to fix, not only that something was wrong.

s2.name: Private
s2.text: Practise the hard sounds as often as you like.

s3.name: Measured
s3.text: Watch your speaking score change over the weeks.

q1.a: Word-by-word scoring is in Gold and Premium. Premium also scores rhythm and intonation.

q2.a: Accuracy is how close each word is to clear speech, fluency is how smoothly you speak, and completeness is how much of what you said was clear.

q3.q: Will it try to change my accent?
q3.a: No. The goal is speech that is easy to understand, not sounding like someone else.

q4.q: Where do I see my scores?
q4.a: Next to the call in Voice Lab, and as your speaking skill on the dashboard.

goals.standfirst: Choose what you want to improve and by when. Each goal shows its progress, and your teacher can set goals for you too.
goals.heroAlt: The Goals screen in Tutelage AI with goals, their progress and who set them
goals.flowText: A goal turns "I want to get better" into a target you can see, with a date and a plan.

s1.name: Choose
s1.text: Pick a type and a target, and add a date and a plan if you like.

s2.name: Practise
s2.text: Your goals stay in view while you chat, speak and review words.

s3.name: Finish
s3.text: Update your progress and complete goals to unlock achievements.

n1.name: A goal
n1.text: Its type, what you want to reach, and a short plan.

n2.name: Progress
n2.text: How far you are, next to the difficulty you chose.

n3.name: From your teacher
n3.text: Teachers can set goals for you. The goal shows who set it.

n4.name: Filters
n4.text: Show active, completed or paused goals, or one type only.

n5.name: Finished goals
n5.text: Completed goals stay on the list, marked as done.

n6.name: New goal
n6.text: Add a goal in a few seconds.

goals.whyStatement: A clear target makes it easier to start practising every day.

s1.name: Focus
s1.text: You know what today’s practice is for.

s2.name: Visible
s2.text: Progress is a number you can see, not a feeling.

s3.name: Shared
s3.text: Your teacher can set goals with you, so you work on the same thing.

q1.q: What kinds of goals can I set?
q1.a: Vocabulary, speaking, grammar, conversation and study time.

q2.q: Can my teacher give me goals?
q2.a: Yes. If you are in a class, your teacher can set goals for you, and you get a notification.

q3.a: Milestones such as a 7-day streak, 100 chats, 1,000 words or 5 finished goals.

q4.a: Yes. A goal can be active, paused or completed.

analytics.standfirst: Your dashboard shows what to do next, how today is going, and how your skills and habits change over the weeks.
analytics.heroAlt: The Tutelage AI dashboard with the next step, today’s goal ring and four stat cards
analytics.flowText: Everything you do in the app feeds one dashboard, so you always know where you stand.

s1.name: Practise
s1.text: Every message you send counts toward today’s minutes and your streak.

s2.name: Measure
s2.text: Your skills are worked out from your latest scored messages.

s3.name: Decide
s3.text: The dashboard suggests one next step: a task, words to review, or a short chat.

n1.name: Skills
n1.text: Four skills, a plain word for each score, and what they are based on.

n2.name: This week
n2.text: Your minutes for each day, against your daily goal.

n3.name: Class work
n3.text: Tasks from your classes, with missing ones first.

n4.name: Recent chats
n4.text: Your latest chats and their scores. Open any of them again.

n5.name: Last 12 weeks
n5.text: Every day you practised, shaded by how much.

n6.name: Vocabulary
n6.text: Words waiting for review, and how your list is growing.

analytics.whyStatement: Seeing small progress is what keeps you going.

s1.name: One next step
s1.text: You never open the app wondering what to do.

s2.name: Your own days
s2.text: Days and streaks follow your time zone, not the server’s.

s3.name: Honest numbers
s3.text: No score is shown until there is something to base it on.

q1.a: While you chat, the time between your messages counts, up to five minutes at a time.

q2.a: When a whole day passes in your time zone without any practice.

q3.q: Where do the skill scores come from?
q3.a: From the AI’s scores for your latest 40 messages. Speaking comes from the spoken ones.

q4.a: If you are in a class, your teacher sees your skills, practice and class work.
